command_line:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

gene = "PA14_09540"
query = f"gene_exact:{gene} AND organism_id:208964"
params = urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "query": query,
    "format": "tsv",
    "fields": "accession,id,protein_name,gene_names,xref_kegg",
    "size": "100",
})
url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?" + params
request = urllib.request.Request(
    url,
    headers={"User-Agent": "Galaxy-UniProt-crossref-probe/1.0", "Accept": "text/tab-separated-values"},
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
    body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
with open("uniprot_pa14_crossref.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write(body)
print("queried", gene)
PY
